sourcePolicy: Three genuine Brazilian Portuguese Android 1.0.16 (19) captures obtained with official adb in a new isolated API 35 emulator, using the previously authorized capture method. Existing test APK installed; visible language setting Português (Brasil) selected. No app source edits or rebuild. Four compositions; rewards and notes reuse the actual candidate board. Only OS bars cropped, full UI uniformly scaled, captions outside the UI. No redrawing or AI bitmap assets.
